options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task-source {held_out,online_mind2web}
                        which task set to evaluate on
  --tasks-file TASKS_FILE
                        JSON/JSONL of EvalTask rows, bypassing the registry
                        loader
  --limit LIMIT         evaluate only the first N tasks
  --label LABEL         run label, e.g. 'before' / 'after' — names the run dir
                        and the report
  --run-id RUN_ID       override the generated run directory name
  --student {mock,openai}
  --endpoint ENDPOINT   OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. http://host:8000/v1)
  --model MODEL         served model id
  --adapter ADAPTER     LoRA/checkpoint path served behind the endpoint
                        (recorded in the report)
  --api-key API_KEY
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --student-timeout STUDENT_TIMEOUT
  --student-retries STUDENT_RETRIES
                        retries for transport errors only; HTTP errors are
                        surfaced
  --mock-trajectory MOCK_TRAJECTORY
                        trajectory.json replayed by the 'mock' student backend
  --coord-space {normalized_1000,viewport_abs}
                        the convention THIS model answers in: a stock Qwen and
                        an sft3 checkpoint emit normalized_1000 (the prompt's
                        0-1000 grid); an sft-v1/v2 checkpoint emits
                        viewport_abs (1280x720 pixels). Set it explicitly per
                        model — it is never auto-detected
  --type-mode {replace,append}
                        driver typing mode; replace selects the focused
                        field's text before typing, as capture and RL do
  --strict-action-grammar
                        accept ONLY the canonical form
                        format_action_for_training emits. Off by default: any
                        unambiguous spelling of a call is accepted, and how
                        canonical each model's output was is reported as
                        canonical_form_rate instead of being charged to its
                        success rate
  --max-unproductive-steps MAX_UNPRODUCTIVE_STEPS
                        abort the episode as 'stuck' after this many steps in
                        a row that execute no action at all
  --max-parse-failures MAX_PARSE_FAILURES
                        abort as 'parse_failure_abort' after this many
                        unparseable steps in a row
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        FLAT step cap per episode; 0 derives one from each
                        task's reference_length
  --step-cap-multiple STEP_CAP_MULTIPLE
                        derived cap = this x the task's reference_length
  --step-cap-floor STEP_CAP_FLOOR
  --step-cap-ceiling STEP_CAP_CEILING
  --stratify            with --limit, keep the task set's easy/medium/hard mix
                        instead of taking the first N rows
  --episode-timeout EPISODE_TIMEOUT
  --screenshot-format {png,jpeg}
                        png only under sft3: effect annotations compare
                        consecutive frames pixel-wise
  --no-judge            record episodes and DEFER the verdict; a later resume
                        judges them off the GPU, so a usage limit can never
                        burn rental hours
  --judge-mid-screenshots JUDGE_MID_SCREENSHOTS
                        mid-run frames per verdict on top of the final one;
                        the main cost dial
  --observation {v2,v3}
                        observation layout: v3 sends prev+current screenshots,
                        v2 sends current only (required for sft-v1/v2 and any
                        GRPO LoRA over them)
  --parallel PARALLEL   concurrent sandboxes (clamped to what the Docker VM
                        can hold)
  --no-resume           re-run episodes that already have an episode.json
  --dataset-revision DATASET_REVISION
  --trajectories-dir TRAJECTORIES_DIR
                        corpus checked by the held_out source to prove a task
                        is unseen
  --loop-guard-repeats LOOP_GUARD_REPEATS
                        driver loop guard for eval; 0 lets a stuck model
                        actually repeat itself
  --sandbox-image SANDBOX_IMAGE
  --browser-backend {docker,remote_ssh,vast_residential}
                        where the browser runs, i.e. which IP the sites see.
                        `vast_residential` rents a US consumer-ISP box and
                        destroys it after.
  --browser-host BROWSER_HOST
                        remote_ssh backend: host or host:port of an already-
                        running box
